### Props

| Name           | Type     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `openbuiltUrl` | `string` | ✓        | —       | Absolute URL or Nextcloud-relative path for the OpenBuilt CTA.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `llmSkillsUrl` | `string` | ✓        | —       | Absolute URL for the LLM-skills CTA (opens in a new tab).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `suggestUrl`   | `string` |          | `''`    | Optional override for the Suggest CTA. When set, the CTA renders as an anchor pointing at this URL — appropriate when the app routes feature suggestions through a public form, a Discord channel, or any non-forge target. The hosting view now always passes a URL (the forge's feature-request issue form by default), so the empty-string button-that-emits-`@suggest` path is a legacy fallback for standalone mounts. External URLs (matching `^https?://`) open in a new tab. |

### Events

| Name      | Payload | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `suggest` | —       | Emitted when the user clicks the Suggest-feature CTA inside the sidebar (only when `suggestUrl` is empty — a legacy path: the hosting view now always passes the forge's feature-request form URL, rendering the CTA as an anchor instead). |
| `support` | —       | Emitted when the user clicks the "Show support note" CTA in the fourth sidebar container. The parent view binds this to its `openSupportDialog` so a freshly-mounted `CnSupportDialog` carries the host-app context.                        |
